description: Put the user's resume on their AI Applyd account as the base every application is tailored from. Pass exactly one: resume_text (the full text), resume_url (an https link to a PDF, DOCX or plain text file, up to 10 MB), or document_id (one of their saved resumes, from aiapplyd_get_account). A new upload is read by AI and uses the user's AI credits; switching to a saved resume with document_id is free. It also finishes account setup, so AI Applyd starts finding jobs for them. Use it when aiapplyd_get_account shows no resume on file, or when the user gives a new one. Do not use it to rewrite or score a resume; use aiapplyd_optimize_resume or aiapplyd_score_resume. Next: aiapplyd_get_matches.

document_id.description: One of the user's saved resumes to make the base (an id from aiapplyd_get_account). Free. Pass this OR resume_text OR resume_url.

resume_text.description: The full text of the resume. Pass this OR resume_url OR document_id.

resume_url.description: An https link to the resume file: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB. Pass this OR resume_text OR document_id.

name: aiapplyd_set_resume

documentId.description: The resume now used as the base for every application.

onboardingCompleted.description: True when the account setup is finished, so AI Applyd searches for this user.

parsed.description: False when the resume is still being read; call aiapplyd_get_account in a minute.

preferencesSeeded.description: True when empty job preferences were filled from this resume.

title: Set Resume
